# Trends World

> The top trending topic in 176 countries and regions, refreshed every three hours.
> Static JSON, no API key, no authentication, no rate limit beyond caches.

Trends World collects the single hottest topic of the day for each country and region,
links every entry to the article that reported it, and groups topics that are trending
in more than one country at once. Content rights belong to the original sources; this
site only indexes and links.

## Data

- [Country list](https://trends-world.pages.dev/data/countries.json): 176 places with ISO codes, English/Chinese names, continent and coordinates.
- [Top topic per country](https://trends-world.pages.dev/data/board.json): the headline, source and link for every place in the current snapshot.
- [Snapshot metadata](https://trends-world.pages.dev/data/meta.json): generation time, coverage out of 176, source distribution, failed places.
- [Cross-border stories](https://trends-world.pages.dev/data/global.json): clusters of the same topic topping several countries, each with a slug.

Per-country details live at `/data/details/<ISO>.json` (for example
`https://trends-world.pages.dev/data/details/JP.json`).

## Pages

- [World map](https://trends-world.pages.dev/): all 176 places on a heat map.
- [All countries](https://trends-world.pages.dev/countries/): plain HTML index with today's top topic per place.
- [Topics](https://trends-world.pages.dev/topics/): stories trending in several countries.
- [Feed](https://trends-world.pages.dev/feed.xml): Atom feed of the cross-border stories.
- [API notes](https://trends-world.pages.dev/api/): endpoint reference with field definitions.

## For agents

An MCP server is included in the repository (`mcp/trends-mcp.mjs`, zero dependencies)
exposing four read-only tools: `trending_by_country`, `global_pulse`,
`search_countries`, `snapshot_status`.

Usage rules that matter:

- Sources are not uniform: `google-trends` measures search interest, `bing-news`
  measures same-day news interest. Name the source when quoting a number.
- `traffic` values such as `200+` are source-side buckets, not measurements.
- Clusters are built from headline similarity, so membership is not geographic.

## Optional

- [About](https://trends-world.pages.dev/about/): methodology, sources, coverage gaps, limitations.
- [Privacy](https://trends-world.pages.dev/privacy/): no accounts, no cookies, only cookieless aggregate counts.
